title: Accounts Administrator
description:

Rise Technical Recruitment Ltd acts an employment agency for permanent roles and an employment business for temporary roles.

title: Credit Controller
company: BC Financial Search Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
BC Financial Search is delighted to be recruiting for a Credit Controller to join a highly regarded, independent professional services business based in Liverpool city centre.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established and successful business with a strong reputation across the North West and a genuine commitment to developing and supporting its people.

The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting the finance function, ensuring outstanding payments are managed effectively whilst maintaining positive relationships with clients and colleagues.

Offering a competitive salary of £25,000-£30,000, hybrid working and an attractive benefits package, this position would suit an experienced Credit Controller looking for their next opportunity within a friendly and professional environment.

Duties and responsibilities

Key responsibilities are expected to include:
- Managing outstanding invoices and proactively following up overdue payments.
- Maintaining accurate debtor records and monitoring outstanding balances.
- Building and maintaining positive working relationships with clients to support timely payments.
- Handling payment queries and resolving discrepancies efficiently and professionally.
- Preparing and issuing customer statements and payment reminders.
- Liaising with colleagues across the business regarding outstanding invoices and account queries.
- Supporting the reconciliation of customer accounts and allocation of payments.
- Monitoring aged debt and providing regular updates on outstanding balances.
- Assisting with wider finance and administrative duties as required.

Experience and qualifications

We are keen to speak with candidates who have previous experience in credit control or accounts receivable and who enjoy working in a professional, client-focused environment.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller or similar finance position.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to discuss outstanding payments professionally.
- Good organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when maintaining financial records.
- A proactive and approachable attitude towards resolving queries.
- Good IT skills, including Excel and experience using accounting or finance systems.
- The ability to work independently whilst contributing positively to a wider team.

Previous experience within a professional services environment would be advantageous, although candidates from other industry backgrounds are also encouraged to apply.

Benefits

This opportunity offers an attractive benefits package alongside the chance to join a respected and established professional services business that places considerable importance on its people, culture and development.

Benefits include:
- Competitive salary of £25,000-£30,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working, offering flexibility between home and the Liverpool city centre office.
- Generous annual leave, with the option to purchase additional holiday.
- An additional day off for your birthday.
- Healthcare benefits, including access to Medicash.
- Group life assurance.
- Enhanced parental leave.
- Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
- A supportive, collaborative working environment within a well-established business.

Company culture

Our client is a highly regarded, independent professional services business with an established presence across the North West.

Despite its size and reputation, the business remains focused on providing a personal service to its clients and creating a supportive, inclusive environment for its employees.

The company places a strong emphasis on teamwork, professional development and building lasting relationships, making this an attractive opportunity for someone who values stability, flexibility and being part of a successful local business.

For an experienced Credit Controller seeking a new challenge within a professional and welcoming environment, this could be an excellent next step.

Please apply with your CV or contact Ben Copsey at BC Financial Search directly for a confidential discussion.

title: Purchase ledger clerk
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Senior Purchase Ledger Clerk - Detailed Job Description

The Senior Purchase Ledger Clerk is responsible for managing the full purchase ledger function, ensuring all supplier invoices, expenses and payments are processed accurately, promptly and in line with internal policies. The role requires a dependable, organised and detail-focused individual who can work independently, uphold high standards of integrity, and support the wider finance team in maintaining accurate financial records.

Working under the general supervision of a Finance Manager or department lead, the Senior Purchase Ledger Clerk oversees day-to-day ledger activities, maintains supplier accounts, manages payment schedules and supports financial reporting. The role is suited to someone with strong purchase ledger experience, excellent reconciliation skills and the ability to work confidently in a busy accounts environment.

Key ResponsibilitiesPurchase Ledger Management
- Process high volumes of supplier invoices on a daily basis.
- Match purchase orders to invoices and ensure correct supporting documentation is provided.
- Code, post and maintain accurate ledger entries.
- Ensure invoices are approved in a timely manner by liaising with relevant departments.
- Maintain clear and organised records in line with internal procedures.

Supplier Account Reconciliation
- Regularly reconcile supplier statements to ensure balances are accurate.
- Investigate discrepancies, resolve issues and correct ledger entries where required.
- Maintain strong communication with suppliers to resolve queries efficiently.

Payment Scheduling
- Prepare weekly and monthly payment runs.
- Produce recommended payment lists aligned with cashflow targets.
- Ensure payments are processed accurately and on time.

Expenses Management
- Become fully knowledgeable in the organisation's expenses policy.
- Ensure all staff expenses comply with internal rules and HMRC regulations.
- Process expenses accurately and support any policy reviews or updates.

Direct Debits & Standing Orders
- Maintain records of all direct debits and standing orders relating to the purchase ledger.
- Ensure payments are valid, authorised and correctly posted.
- Manage supplier details within banking interfaces, ensuring names and bank information are accurate and verified.

Financial Systems & Reporting
- Use financial systems effectively, with experience in Sage 1000 or Sage X3 considered advantageous.
- Assist with preparing reports and analysis required for statutory accounts.
- Support the Finance Manager with accurate financial information and documentation.

Documentation & Compliance
- Maintain thorough, accurate and secure financial records.
- Follow all relevant Standard Operating Procedures.
- Ensure documentation is stored in a way that allows prompt retrieval.
- Uphold confidentiality across all financial, supplier and system-related information.

Additional Duties
- Undertake reasonable additional tasks aligned with experience and departmental needs.
- Support wider business objectives and collaborate with other departments when required.

Person SpecificationEssential
- Minimum two years' purchase ledger experience.
- Experience working in a busy accounts office.
- Strong reconciliation skills, including PO-to-invoice matching and supplier statement reconciliation.
- Experience processing expenses and understanding HMRC requirements.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Dependable, punctual and hardworking.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work with other departments.
- Demonstrates commitment, reliability, responsibility and integrity.
- Able to work full-time hours.

Desirable
- AAT qualified or part-qualified.
- Experience with Sage 1000 or Sage X3.
- Ability to work independently and use initiative.
- Flexible and willing to take on new tasks.
- Willingness to travel to other sites if required.

Summary

This role is ideal for an experienced Purchase Ledger professional who enjoys taking ownership of their workload, thrives in a fast-paced finance environment and values accuracy, integrity and reliability. The Senior Purchase Ledger Clerk plays a vital part in maintaining financial control, supporting payment processes and contributing to the organisation's wider financial objectives.
